quizTitle: Entertainment Industry: Big Money & Shocking Facts

questions.question: The global entertainment market is valued at more than how many trillion US dollars? (2020-2025 estimates)
About how much did producing a major Hollywood blockbuster cost-on‐average in 2023?
One of the most famous films, Titanic (1997), cost roughly how much to make — reportedly more than the ship itself?
In the film & TV world, the term “Hollywood accounting” refers to what practice?
options: Studios paying huge dividends to actors
Studios using creative accounting so a profitable film appears unprofitable
Studios giving large bonuses for profits
questions.answer: Studios using creative accounting so a profitable film appears unprofitable

questions.question: In the music industry, the global music market revenue in 2022 was approximately how much?
What is the estimated average cost to produce a major music festival in 2023 (before ticket-sales etc.)?
Which of the following is true about streaming and digital in entertainment (2023–25)?
options: Streaming is less than 20% of entertainment revenue
Streaming now makes up the majority of music market revenue
Only theatrical box-office counts for big revenue
questions.answer: Streaming now makes up the majority of music market revenue

questions.question: Which region or country produces the largest number of films each year, in one of the biggest film industries globally?
Which of these is a shocking truth for many about touring bands, even if they play many shows?
options: They always make huge profits from every tour
Many smaller bands still run at a loss despite heavy touring costs
Touring is cheap for musicians nowadays
Ticket-sales always fully cover production costs
questions.answer: Many smaller bands still run at a loss despite heavy touring costs

questions.question: Why are many series and films now so expensive to produce per episode or film?
options: Because of increased budgets for CGI, star salaries & marketing
Because production companies pay less for content
Because filming is faster than ever
questions.answer: Because of increased budgets for CGI, star salaries & marketing
